verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Fastmail is a SaaS service with a public developer API, so it could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. JMAP's machine-readable session discovery and the IETF RFC specs are developer building blocks and runtime discovery, not docs written for AI agents, so they get no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
